what: Add `pub fn log_mut(&mut self, f: impl FnOnce(&mut Db)) -> Vec<salsa::Event>` to `base_db::Db` in crates/base-db/src/db.rs, beside `Db::log`: the same as `log` (clone the log Arc, set Some(Vec::new()), run f(self), take), but f gets `&mut Db`. Why: maintainers run inside a write (`set_file_text` etc.), so the queries a maintainer reads execute during the write; `Db::log(&self, FnOnce())` cannot wrap a write. The nameres delta trace tests (crates/hir-def/src/nameres/delta/tests/trace.rs, design dbsp.md section 12 "a reader sees only its slice") need the events of the write itself, as will dbsp-impls trace tests. Same panic as `log` on a database with no log. Tests only in effect; no build path changes.

history.note: Db::log_mut(&mut self, FnOnce(&mut Db)) -> Vec<salsa::Event> added beside Db::log in crates/base-db/src/db.rs
